hook.name: StarbaseHookV1
hook.description: Applies a 4% buy tax on FLT/WBNB swaps, routing portions to a burn address (1%), an operations wallet (1%), and a space fund (2%), collected via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Tracks Blueprint NFT mint credits and burn obligations per user on each swap. Requires hookData with the swap user address (≥32 bytes); reverts for senders not in the trusted-router allowlist.
